save.text: Episode number: 47 announced; 50th episode upcoming in three episodes with surprises and a Critmas blowout after it. (confirmed by Matt)
Sam announced he's voice directing DreamWorks cartoon 'Home' series coming out in a week. (Sam, turn 63)

Merch: Gilmore's Glorious Goods shirts pre-order deadline discussed—Travis said 'tomorrow at midnight' but ambiguity about whether that's tonight or tomorrow night; Matt advised order tonight to be safe. (turns 26–45)
Marisha: last episode of Signal Boost this Tuesday; she rotates hosts but will still produce it. (Marisha, turns 76–87)
Liam: free shipping available; he's sitting in the kitchen he grew up in and playing D&D there; has dice with Laura present. (Liam, turns 69, 94; Laura mentions dice, turn 71)
Gern Blanston: went back into Cindergrove to collect red dragon scales after battle; lost sight of him, whereabouts unknown. (Matt, turn 114)

Scanlan (Sam) cast Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion creating an extradimensional mansion; invited refugees and Pyrah tribe; mansion staffed by ethereal servants who can wait on guests; some servants were struck by Craven Edge and dispersed. (turns 139–146, 152, 160–166, 186, 189–199)
Merch/ordering note replaced: Scanlan offered lodging to all refugees and mentioned a guest list/door attendant; Pyrah tribe continued building shelters despite offer. (turns 181–187)
Liam (Vax) questioned being sent ahead; indicated willingness as long as Scanlan didn't 'whip out the cube'. (turns 155–158)
Scanlan demonstrates mansion servants are obedient 'slave ghosts'; he commands one to braid his chest hair and they respond they 'enjoy their purpose' (turns 212–219).

Scanlan says mansion contains ~100 servants: 50 assigned to him, rest available to others; servants can manifest food/drink, make physical contact, and items can become solid (turns 249–259, 264–266, 253–255).
Scanlan describes mansion rooms: individual rooms upstairs; his room larger at end of hallway; adjacent rooms reserved for Pike and 'Kaylie' (turns 268–276, 269–271).
Door to mansion is invitation-only (only invited can enter). (confirmed by Sam)
Mansion-door teleport/creation effect can be cast once per day; takes one minute to cast, so not usable mid-battle. (Sam/Matt, turns 284–291)

Servants can manifest solid-feeling spectral items (e.g., a spectral cow with weight; disperses when dismissed). They have limited resources (could produce a cow but not a squid). (Matt/Sam, turns 320–349)
Downstairs room appeared: basement training chamber with sand pit, dummies, chains, weapon/armor racks; door appeared where none before. (Matt, turn 360)
Trinket (bear) trained with Grog: Trinket attack +8 hit for 7 bludgeoning; Grog held and succeeded STR save (26) so not knocked over; Trinket later seeks Vex. (turns 384–395, 434)
Vex absent during training; her absence made Trinket antsy and leave to find her. (turn 434)
Vex (Laura) took Gern's enchanted broom; broom requires a spoken code word in Draconic (archaic) meaning 'candle' to activate. (turns 452–523)
Scanlan (Sam) examined broom: Arcana 14 -> item enchanted; Investigation 21 -> found hidden scrawled phrase in unknown language later identified as archaic Draconic. (turns 493–498, 519–521)
Activation details: broom's enchantment requires wielder to speak the phrase; when 'candle' (Draconic) spoken broom briefly lifted Vex off bed then functioned. (turns 494–523)

Broom flight: saying Draconic word 'candle' activated broom; Vex rode it, made Dex check (20) to catch herself; she practiced and learned basic steering; was exhausted. (turns 542–555, 547–552, 548–550)
Scanlan/party reaction: Scanlan insisted Vex owes nothing; encouraged helping others to repay karma; Scanlan says he'll assign someone for Vex to help later. (turns 527, 556–570)
Keyleth door knock: Cerkonos visited Keyleth at night; his previously missing arm is slowly regenerating; he asked to sit and speak about unease. (turns 593–601)

Cerkonos recounts Pyrah finding a girl who tore open the Gate; named Raishan, likely the green dragon involved in Conclave attack; girl arrived ~age 15, now ~19-20; Cerkonos feels guilt. (turns 603–621)
Keyleth/party know name Raishan from Conclave attack on Emon; Marisha/Keyleth to watch for info and to search notes. (turns 626–631)
Earlier merch/ordering note replaced: Scanlan offered lodging to all refugees and mentioned a guest list/door attendant; Pyrah tribe continued building shelters despite offer. (turns 181–187)
Trinket at breakfast: Trinket covered in breakfast food, sitting at edge of table, bowing wooden bench creaks; Trinket previously trained with Grog and later sought Vex. (turns 674, 384–395, 434)

Vex confirms she can fly using stolen broom from Gern (she admits theft); party discusses testing storage in mansion (Trinket/broom left to test persistence). Vex plans to keep broom. (turns 670–671, 675, 682–711)
Trinket present at breakfast, covered in food; trained with Grog earlier and later sought Vex; currently antsy when Vex absent. (observed turn 715–716, 743, 774, earlier turns 384–395, 434)

Vex actively flying on Gern's stolen enchanted broom; practicing archery from broom with mixed success (Dex check 13 then attack with disadvantage 16 hit/turkey; second Dex 13 failure). She intends to keep/use broom and will practice with Percy's engineering help. (turns 715–753, 757–796, 803)
Broom confirmed usable for flight and archery; Percy (Taliesin) to design a seat/stabilizer and may require funds; Vex promises to compensate. (turns 757–763, 770–796, 797)
Cerkonos reports Raishan infiltrated Fire Ashari ~4 years ago disguised as a ~15-year-old human woman; she ripped open the rift and later went to Emon (confirmed by Marisha, turns 819–841).
Party discusses next destinations: retrieve Titanstone Knuckles of Kord from Kevdak/tribe and consult a sphinx (Whitestone); alternate: visit library. Grog's family reunion mentioned (turns 875–892).
Trinket remains antsy when Vex absent; during current scene Vex not present at table (implied by earlier notes and Vex absence in camp discussion, referenced context turns 715–716, 872–874).
Party decides next destination: head toward Westruun area to find Grog's herd (to retrieve Titanstone Knuckles) and/or Frostweald; consensus to go to Grog's herd. (turns 893–920, 912–919)

Mansion/door notes unchanged; new planning: group discusses using Trinket/Keyleth-as-wolf/Trinket for tracking; Marisha can wild-shape into a wolf to help find herd; Trinket can smell. (turns 955–957)

Grog's herd size estimated ~6 members; Grog expects leader (uncle) won't willingly give Knuckles; potential hostile reception due to past conflict where Grog was beaten/left for dead. (turns 964–971, 925–936)
Party decides to prioritize visiting the sphinx first (to consult) and then possibly retrieve Titanstone Knuckles from Kevdak; consensus: sphinx first. (turns 1015–1018, 1014)

Frostweald considered as sphinx location; Marisha (Keyleth) cannot recall specific teleportation trees there (Int check 9). Closest recallable tree clusters: Crossroads (middle of Silvercut roadway) and Bramblewood Forest north of Westruun. (turns 1037–1050)
Plan option: use Vex's enchanted broom to transport group (everyone 'hop on Vex's broom' suggested). Marisha can scry or attempt to guide to a tree to teleport. (turns 1044–1046, 1048–1051)
Party chooses Crossroads then Bramblewood/forest; Keyleth uses Wind Walk to transform party into mist to travel faster toward Westruun/Frostweald. (turns 1056–1115)
From mist view approaching Westruun: noticed a ~15–20 ft dirt mound with wooden spikes, glimmering items, haphazard grooves; two people removing a cart from it. (turn 1115)
Group discusses transport options: horseback ~1 day to Frostweald; on foot ~2+ days; Wind Walk/mist form slightly faster than horse; party chooses mist. (turns 1084–1096, 1112–1115)
While approaching Westruun in mist, party saw a dirt mound with coins and claw grooves—it's an offering site; two humanoids hauling a cart removed items. (turns 1115,1119–1124)

From mist above Westruun: several farms intentionally burned in patterns; functioning farms have armed watchers who sometimes assault workers; city entrances have thin battlements/wall. (turns 1132–1141)

Party chose to descend and solidify near high-crop (corn) fields; Vex cast Pass Without a Trace and entire group (including Scanlan, Keyleth, Grog) reverted to physical form and made successful stealth checks. (turns 1162–1171,1179–1191)
From mist view approaching Westruun: noticed a ~15–20 ft dirt mound with wooden spikes, glimmering items, haphazard grooves; two people removing a cart from it. (turn 1115)

At Westruun outskirts: party hiding in crops debating freeing farmers; farmer Reginald (late 40s–50s, gray beard) unaware of party initially, is beaten, says guards working for dragon take people for labor or as warnings, including his daughter; dragon seen every couple days, last at dusk yesterday; patrols unspecified. (turns 1197–1271)
Party initially chose Crossroads then Bramblewood/forest; Keyleth used Wind Walk to transform party into mist to travel faster toward Westruun/Frostweald. (turns 1056–1115)
